en:EQUIP.TUTORIAL_ENHANCE_GEAR_01:
You came to enhance your gear! 
You can enhance your gear by using 
other gear 
for Enhancement Materials!
en:EQUIP.TUTORIAL_ENHANCE_GEAR_02: Now, shall we try enhancing some gear? \nSelect some gear to use as Enhancement \nMaterials!
en:EQUIP.TUTORIAL_ENHANCE_GEAR_03: You can use up to 5 Enhancement \nMaterials at a time! \nShall we start enhancing the gear?
en:EQUIP.TUTORIAL_ENHANCE_GEAR_04: Nice! Your gear is now enhanced! \nCollect more gear and enhance \nyour gear to +5!
en:EQUIP.TUTORIAL_EQUIP_GEAR_00: Here you can equip gear to make \nyour Ranger stronger! \nFirst, select a Ranger to equip gear on!
en:EQUIP.TUTORIAL_EQUIP_GEAR_01:
Gear is composed of 3 slots: 
Weapon, Armor, and Accessory. 
You can equip the right gear 
for your Ranger type!
en:EQUIP.TUTORIAL_EQUIP_GEAR_02: Tap your gear to see its details!  \nTry it now!
en:EQUIP.TUTORIAL_EQUIP_GEAR_03:
If you tap the Equip button 
on the gear details screen, 
it will be equipped!
Now, let's tap the Equip button!
en:EQUIP.TUTORIAL_EQUIP_GEAR_04:
Good job! The gear boosted your 
Ranger's STATS! You can change gear. 
So collect as much gear as you can create 
the most powerful Rangers!
en:EQUIP.TUTORIAL_GEAR_SPECIAL_OPTION_1: 9-Star Gear will get specialized option enhancements that will let you specialize your Rangers' roles!
en:EQUIP.TUTORIAL_GEAR_SPECIAL_OPTION_2: You can enhance the stats of specialized options for 9-Star Gear.
en:EQUIP.TUTORIAL_GEAR_SPECIAL_OPTION_3: To enhance specialized options, you need both materials and a certain number of Coins.
en:EQUIP.TUTORIAL_GEAR_SPECIAL_OPTION_4: Make good use of specialized options to enhance the roles of your Rangers!
